description: Ship, 60-band. Package Praxis for distribution: Tauri desktop bundles (and an optional web build), CI that runs the gates on every PR, and end-user docs that carry a clean first-run through the whole loop (define a subject → AI constructs the tutorials → gated learning). Depends on the full feature set (40 gated learning + 50 storage). Anti-fabrication: the ship story passes only when `tauri build` actually produces a runnable bundle and the documented first-run works end-to-end on a clean machine profile — never on an untested build.
warmup: command -v tauri cargo npm 2>/dev/null; cat src-tauri/tauri.conf.json 2>/dev/null | head -40

userStories.title: Tauri bundles + CI gate
acceptanceCriteria: `tauri build` produces a desktop bundle for at least macOS (note the path for Windows/Linux even if not built here), and an optional web build target is documented.
A CI workflow (.github/workflows) runs the path-scoped gates — cargo build, npm run build, and pytest — on every PR to main, mirroring .chief/verify.sh.
Gate green: the workflow passes on this branch.

userStories.title: User docs + verified first-run
acceptanceCriteria: README documents install, BYO-key setup (and the optional AGORA_BASE_URL), defining a subject, AI construction, gated learning, and choosing a storage backend.
A clean first-run is walked end-to-end (define → construct → learn → progress persists) and documented, with any prerequisites (e.g. Jupyter kernel) called out.
Gate green: build + pytest pass; the first-run walkthrough is recorded in the progress log as actually performed.
